objective.claim: develop a separately attributable automated strategy that beats exact V8

source_symbol_canonicalization.classification: preprice source-name correction for the same two ETF instruments

isolation.existing_runtime_cache_use: one-time copy of non-price account/server session support from a stopped project-local non-Master Lab Portable is allowed; no existing runtime price/history cache may be copied or read for prices, and no other runtime may be executed by this family

excluded_inputs: Family 001 through Family 007 features, models, predictions, decisions, trades and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunity timestamps, component labels, state and economics
Optimization candidate signals, states, ledgers and outcomes
material_distinctions: paired cash and three-times leveraged ETFs rather than a single currency cross or target-only feature
structural close-rebalance pressure rather than generic session continuation, opening response or external context tagging
one theoretically signed continuation population with two predeclared exit realizations rather than post-outcome polarity inversion
one US100 close-pressure action rather than a cross-index basket or multi-symbol allocation

external_series_not_yet_acquired.price_basis: broker-native MT5 Bid OHLC; spread is retained for integrity but does not enter the external signal
external_series_not_yet_acquired.acquisition_path: fresh copy_rates_range through the family-owned dedicated Portable after this declaration reaches origin/main
external_series_not_yet_acquired.receipt_requirements: pin executable, server, both symbol specifications, requested and returned boundaries, row counts, exact columns, file bytes and SHA-256 without querying account, position, order or deal state
external_series_not_yet_acquired.locked_2026_external_values: not requested, acquired or opened until one unchanged complete development passer exists

target_series.price_basis: MT5 rate OHLC are Bid; recorded spread times point reconstructs Ask
target_series.copy_rule: materialize byte-equal once after declaration; development adapter may read only rows before 2026-01-01 and locked rows remain unopened

raw_time_semantics.source_encoding: the integer MT5 time field stores the connected broker server wall-clock as Unix-like epoch seconds; it is not semantic UTC
raw_time_semantics.normalization: interpret the raw epoch as a timezone-naive wall-clock, attach Europe/Helsinki with the IANA database, then convert to true UTC and America/New_York before any date, session, return, rank, risk or path operation
raw_time_semantics.non_authoritative_display_fields: acquisition receipt fields or CSV columns named first_utc, last_utc or time_utc preserve the raw epoch rendering only and must never drive scheduling
raw_time_semantics.dst_and_short_session_rule: exact local-minute completeness remains binding; US/Europe DST-mismatch weeks, half days, missing minutes and duplicates are excluded structurally rather than shifted, filled or rescued
raw_time_semantics.correction_classification: preimplementation source-time semantic correction after a time-column-only diagnostic; no price, spread, volume, return, rank, target path or outcome value was opened

session_clock.dst_rule: the IANA timezone database in the Python adapter owns each local-date conversion
session_clock.clock_is_control_not_signal: the completed paired leveraged-ETF state, not the clock alone, decides whether and which direction to act

common_normal_day.external_completeness: exactly one QQQ and one TQQQ M1 row at every local minute 09:30 through 15:29 inclusive
common_normal_day.target_completeness: exactly one US100 M1 row at every local minute 15:30 through 15:59 inclusive

external_event.qqq_return: QQQ Bid close at 15:29 divided by Bid open at 09:30 minus one
external_event.tqqq_return: TQQQ Bid close at 15:29 divided by Bid open at 09:30 minus one
external_event.direction: sign of the nonzero QQQ return
external_event.coherence: TQQQ return must have the same sign and absolute magnitude at least twice the absolute QQQ return
external_event.reference_population: the previous 60 chronologically complete common normal days, excluding the current local date
external_event.nearest_rank: sort the 60 prior absolute QQQ returns ascending and use one-indexed position 45
external_event.gate: current absolute QQQ return must be nonzero and greater than or equal to the causal nearest-rank threshold, and coherence must pass
external_event.ties: all exact equality cases pass; no epsilon or randomized tie break

decision_geometry.decision_time: immediately after both external 15:29 M1 bars complete
decision_geometry.target_entry_time: the exact US100 M1 row at 15:30 local
decision_geometry.target_future_path: thirty exact US100 M1 rows from 15:30 through 15:59 inclusive
decision_geometry.accepted_direction: LONG US100 for a positive coherent event and SHORT US100 for a negative coherent event
decision_geometry.lifecycle_start_count: the accepted US100 first fill counts once

target_risk_distance.holding_interval_range: US100 Bid high minus Bid low across 15:30 through 15:59 local
target_risk_distance.causal_reference: the previous 20 chronologically complete common normal days, excluding the current date
target_risk_distance.statistic: arithmetic median: mean of one-indexed sorted positions 10 and 11
target_risk_distance.floor: one US100 index price unit, 1.0; this is not one broker point
target_risk_distance.risk_distance: maximum of 1.0 and the causal median holding-interval range

candidate_bundle.shared_signal_population: every gated structurally complete coherent event

variants.exit: adverse stop or mandatory direction-specific close at the end of the thirtieth M1 bar
adverse stop, favorable take, or mandatory direction-specific close at the end of the thirtieth M1 bar
variants.same_bar_stop_and_take: adverse stop wins and exact threshold execution is used

position_and_proxy_execution.long_entry: entry-row Ask reconstructed as Bid open plus entry spread times point
position_and_proxy_execution.long_stop: entry Ask minus one frozen risk distance, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.long_take: entry Ask plus 1.5 frozen risk distances, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.short_stop: entry Bid plus one frozen risk distance, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.short_take: entry Bid minus 1.5 frozen risk distances, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.short_time_exit: Ask close reconstructed from Bid close plus the 15:59 row recorded spread
position_and_proxy_execution.volume_rounding: floor four-percent risk-distance volume to 0.01; use minimum 0.01 only when planned loss is at most six percent of entry actual balance
position_and_proxy_execution.actual_execution: direction-specific Bid/Ask entry, barrier and time-exit prices
position_and_proxy_execution.extra_stress: subtract the same observed direction-specific actual spread burden once more
position_and_proxy_execution.insolvency_or_nonfinite_balance: block later entries without rewriting already completed paths

dimensions: raw signal-direction gross and net before favorable-barrier differences
MFE and MAE in price units and R over the fixed thirty-minute US100 path
time-close versus 1.5R take-profit truncation and stop overlap
observed and doubled-spread cost share relative to gross movement
minimum-lot and aggregate-risk blocks plus capital-depletion sequencing
2024 versus 2025 sign, hit-rate and expectancy stability
positive-event versus negative-event descriptive stability without subgroup execution
improvement_potential_audit.broad_headroom_definition: a sign-stable, cross-year, cost-surviving signal-direction edge or a broad exit truncation visible across the common population rather than an isolated threshold, date, sign, tail or subgroup
improvement_potential_audit.decision_rule: do not close merely because the first or either exit variant fails; complete both variants and this audit, then close only when no broad causal improvement headroom remains
improvement_potential_audit.audit_authority_limit: the audit cannot execute or authorize a new threshold, clock, window, subgroup, symbol, direction, risk, sizing or exit; any genuinely new economic variant requires a later whole-map comparison and a separately named durable declaration before execution

python_adapter_owns: fresh QQQ and TQQQ source and symbol-specification integrity
broker-server Europe/Helsinki wall-clock normalization to true UTC, IANA New York local-date conversion and exact common-day completeness
completed paired returns, sixty-day QQQ rank, coherence and continuation direction
decision schema, sequence, freshness and bounded decision evidence
ea_must_own: adapter schema, variant, sequence and freshness validation
US100 contract, tick size, tick value, lot and market-state validation
balance-based volume and six-percent hard risk cap
protective stop, optional variant take and 15:59 timed close
ownership, persistence, restart recovery and bounded execution evidence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net, then frozen variant order

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged variant passes development, locked confirmation and whole proxy challenge gates
required_architecture: family-owned Python adapter and byte-pinned decision tape
native_escalation.tester_model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with 100% real ticks

ordered_stages: declaration before dedicated runtime, external acquisition, target copy, rank, implementation or economics
fresh development-only QQQ and TQQQ acquisition plus specifications and byte-equal US100 materialization
complete adapter implementation freeze with timestamp, rank, coherence, sign-count and risk-feasibility structure only
one complete 2024-2025 two-variant development bundle plus mandatory improvement-potential audit
locked 2026 external acquisition and confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained Python adapter plus EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.one_variant_failure: continue the already frozen sibling variant and improvement-potential audit; do not close from the first economic view
stop_rules.no_development_passer_and_no_broad_headr: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 after both variants and the frozen audit complete
stop_rules.no_development_passer_but_broad_headroom: record one bounded successor seed only; do not execute it inside V1, and recompare all active macro programs before any separately named declaration
stop_rules.confirmation_or_whole_proxy_failure: close before EA and MT5 after recording the same frozen audit dimensions
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
